problem.read: We could not open your report form.
problem.readBody: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was sent.
problem.wrongPerson: This link is not for you.
problem.invalid: Some answers need a look before we can take the report.
problem.invalidBody: We took you to the first one. Nothing was sent.
problem.aboveSold: You asked to send back more than you can.
problem.aboveSoldBody: We read what can still come back again: lower the pieces where it says so. Nothing was sent.
problem.changed: Something changed while you were writing.
problem.changedBody: We read the page again. Check your answers and send again. Nothing was sent.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time.
problem.rateLimitedBody: Wait a minute, then try again. Your answers are still here.
problem.unavailable: We could not reach the server.
problem.unavailableBody: Your answers are still here. Try again: the report goes only once.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
problem.internalBody: Your answers are still here. Try again: the report goes only once.

type.title: What do you need?
type.lead: Choose one. Each choice asks only its own questions.

item.title: Which item?
item.lead: Pick it from what {sender} sent you.

details.title: Tell us more
details.lead: A few questions so we understand what happened.

photos.title: Photos
photos.lead: Show us the problem. You can circle it on the photo.

review.title: Check and send
review.lead: This is what {sender} receives. Change anything before you send.

nav.keys: ← → move between the steps when no field is in use.

type.later: For a repair or alteration, a made-to-measure remake or a safety incident, write to {sender} directly for now.

RETURN.title: Send something back
RETURN.body: A wrong size, a wrong item, or something damaged: ask to send it back, and say what you would like instead.
RETURN.none: Nothing of this delivery can be sent back now. You can still report a quality problem.

COMPLAINT.title: Report a quality problem
COMPLAINT.body: Something is not right with how it is made: tell us, our quality team looks into it and answers you.

item.nothingBack: Nothing of {record} can be sent back now.
item.nothingBackBody: It may already be on its way back, or not delivered yet. For a quality problem you can still write to us here; for anything else, ask {sender}.
item.late: Past the usual return period: you can still ask, we decide.
item.serialHint: On the label inside the garment, if it has one. Scan it or type it.
item.batchHint: On the label, if there is no serial number.
item.whole: Not one item: the whole delivery
item.wholeBody: The problem is with the delivery as a whole, or with something not in the list.
item.unknown: An item no longer in the list

details.reasonNoteHint: Where on the garment, and since when.
details.outcomeHint: We decide once we have looked at it; your wish helps.
details.yourRefHint: Your own number for this, if you keep one: we quote it when we write.
details.noteHint: For example when you can send the goods back.
details.descriptionHint: What is wrong, where on the garment, when you noticed it, and how it was worn or used.

photos.intro: Photos help us decide faster. Take them in good light; keep faces out of the picture.
photos.after: The photos go with your report when you send it. They stay on this page until then.
photos.needed: At least {needed} photos of the damage: {count} added.
photos.label: Photo {n}
photos.dialogIntro: Take the photo or pick one from your device, then circle the problem with an arrow or a circle.

review.name: Your name (optional)
review.nameHint: So we know whom to answer.

held.expired: This link has expired: ask {sender} for a new one.
held.used: This link takes no more reports: ask {sender} for a new one.

later.held: Nothing to keep yet: choose what you need first.
later.savedBody: Open this same link again to finish, until {day}. Photos are not kept: add them again then.

draft.restored: We kept what you wrote on {day} at {time}.
draft.restoredBody: Go on where you left off. Photos are not kept: add them again.

check.items: Pick at least one item that comes back.
check.nothingBack: Nothing can be sent back now: report a quality problem instead.
check.manyItems: At most {max} items in one request.
check.itemGone: This item can no longer come back: remove it.
check.complaintItem: Pick the item, or “the whole delivery”.
check.photos_one: Add {count} more photo: a damage needs at least {needed}.
check.photos_other: Add {count} more photos: a damage needs at least {needed}.

refusal.quantity: More than can still come back: lower it.

next.RETURN: We look at your request and tell you whether to send it back, with the return instructions to print.
next.COMPLAINT: Our quality team looks into it and answers you.

done.again: Open this same link until {day} to see where it stands.
done.noMore: This link takes no more reports: for news, ask {sender}.

photos.failed_one: {count} photo did not go: try again below.
photos.failed_other: {count} photos did not go: try again below.
photos.sent_one: Your photo is with the report.
photos.sent_other: Your {count} photos are with the report.
photos.failedBody: The report itself was sent. Try again; the photos already sent stay.

cases.hint: Where your earlier reports stand. Report something new below.
cases.openFailed: It did not open: try again.

scan.title: Scan the label
scan.intro: Hold the label's code in the frame. The serial number fills in by itself.

state.failed: The camera did not start (no camera, or not allowed). Close this and type the serial number.
state.none: No camera here. Close this and type the serial number.
